title: Shape of a configuration code
statement: Suppose $y=\langle x,\langle\operatorname{bits}(c),\operatorname{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$. If a machine configuration on input $x$ has code $c$ at scale $s$, then $y$ has the asserted shape: it has that pairing form, and the length of the binary representation of $s$ is at most the length of the binary representation of $y$'s length.
hypotheses_covered: y is the stated pairing of x and the binary representations of c and s
A machine configuration C on input x
The configuration code of C at scale s equals c
